title: Movement integration
summary: Aim and movement are inseparable in FPS games, and aim trainers can isolate useful movement-linked practice through dodge, strafe, and anti-movement scenario types.
cues: Train aim while moving instead of treating mouse control and movement as separate universes
Use strafe or dodge scenarios for basic aim-while-moving adaptation
Use anti-movement scenarios to learn how shifting position changes the mouse response
failureModes: Assuming movement can never be trained at all inside an aim trainer
Expecting movement scenarios to fully replace real player-vs-player dodging
